content.text:
In the settings window, each system prompt's editor now grows to fit its whole prompt instead of being 120 pixels tall with its own scrollbar. Only the settings page scrolls. That includes the spec-reading prompt under Injected prompts. The spec builds, and 273 of 274 tests pass; the one failure is the same `...`/`…` default-prompt test as before. I haven't looked at it in the running app.

- **Spec:** `spec/scope/settings-window/index.pi` now says each editor grows to fit its prompt with no maximum, the same way the chat input and commit message box grow. The wheel over an editor scrolls the page.
- **Code:**
  - In `src/settings_window.rs`, each prompt editor gets its own sizing, using the same mechanism as the chat input and commit message box. It no longer allows scrolling past the last line.
  - Because an editor now has nothing of its own to scroll, the mouse wheel over it passes through to the page.
  - A small change in `src/growing_input.rs` lets each of the several editors keep its own size.
- **Test:** the new `prompt_editors_grow_to_fit` test checks that an editor holding 40 lines is over 20 times as tall as one holding a single line.
